details: swban help                  #List common commands and descriptions
swban help check/csp        #(Example) Show full help for a command
swban help 1                #List top-level commands (/ marks categories; other paths are executable)
swban help 2                #List commands and categories through level 2; higher numbers are supported
swban help check 2          #List commands and categories two levels below check
swban help check/browser 3  #List commands and categories three levels below check/browser
Site development and builds:
swban base/hugo server -D --disableFastRender -b localhost -p 5678  #Start the development server
swban base/hugo --minify --gc --cleanDestinationDir                 #Build production output
swban base/hugo --minify --destination ./preview                    #Build to a specified directory
Tools:
swban base/hugo/ensure            #Prepare Hugo
swban base/go/ensure              #Prepare Go
swban base/git/ensure             #Prepare Git
swban base/gh/ensure              #Prepare gh (GitHub CLI)
swban base/bun/ensure             #Prepare Bun
swban base/browser/ensure         #Prepare Playwright/Chromium
swban base/<tool> [arguments...]  #Run bun/node/git/gh/go/hugo; forward arguments unchanged
Checks:
swban check/banyan [directory]  #Check that the theme version matches this Skill
swban check/delivery [dir]      #Check data/delivery.toml and its rendered output
swban check/csp [dir]           #Check CSP and inline hashes
swban check/browser/site [dir]  #Run browser checks
swban report/size/html [dir]    #Report page size and size on first load
swban sync/ext [id...]          #Sync declared external resources
Theme developers:
swban base/git tag v0.1.0 HEAD                                                     #Tag the project version
swban base/git tag module/v0.1.0 HEAD                                              #Tag the Go Module version
swban base/git push --atomic --no-follow-tags origin tag v0.1.0 tag module/v0.1.0  #Push both version tags for the same commit
swban base/gh auth login --web                                                     #Sign in to GitHub
swban base/gh release create <tag> --verify-tag --notes <URL>                      #Link release notes
swban help                  #列出常用命令和说明
swban help check/csp        #(示例)查看具体命令说明
swban help 1                #列出所有一级命令（含/结尾的是分类，否则为可执行，下同）
swban help 2                #列出所有一至二级命令和分类,数字可以大于2
swban help check 2          #列出 check 下两层命令和分类
swban help check/browser 3  #列出 check/browser 下三层命令和分类
站点开发与构建：
swban base/hugo server -D --disableFastRender -b localhost -p 5678 #启动开发服
swban base/hugo --minify --gc --cleanDestinationDir  #生产构建
swban base/hugo --minify --destination ./preview     #构建到指定目录
工具：
swban base/hugo/ensure      #准备 Hugo
swban base/go/ensure        #准备 Go
swban base/git/ensure       #准备 Git
swban base/gh/ensure        #准备 gh (GitHub CLI)
swban base/bun/ensure       #准备 Bun
swban base/browser/ensure   #准备 Playwright/Chromium
swban base/<tool> [参数...] #运行 bun/node/git/gh/go/hugo ,参数会原样转发
检测：
swban check/banyan [目录]      #检查主题与本 Skill 版本是否配套
swban check/delivery [dir]     #检查 data/delivery.toml 及其渲染产物
swban check/csp [dir]          #检查 CSP 与内联哈希
swban check/browser/site [dir] #执行浏览器检查
swban report/size/html [dir]   #统计页面与首次加载体积
swban sync/ext [id...]         #同步已声明的外部资源
主题开发者：
swban base/git tag v0.1.0 HEAD        #标记项目版本
swban base/git tag module/v0.1.0 HEAD #标记 Go Module 版本
swban base/git push --atomic --no-follow-tags origin tag v0.1.0 tag module/v0.1.0 #推送同一提交的两个版本标签
swban base/gh auth login --web                                 #登录 GitHub
swban base/gh release create <tag> --verify-tag --notes <URL>  #链接版本记录
